question: Pt. Ram Narayan is a
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarangi player**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pt. Ram Narayan is a renowned Indian musician known for his exceptional skill as a **Sarangi player**.
 
• He is credited with popularizing the Sarangi as a solo concert instrument in Hindustani classical music.
 
• Pt. Ram Narayan's contributions have earned him numerous accolades, including the prestigious **Padma Vibhushan** award.
 
• He has performed extensively both in India and internationally, elevating the status of the Sarangi on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarangi**

 
 
• The Sarangi is a bowed, short-necked string instrument from the Indian subcontinent, used in Hindustani classical music.
 
• It is known for its rich, expressive sound that closely resembles the human voice.
 
• The instrument typically has three main playing strings and a series of sympathetic strings that resonate to create a fuller sound.
 
 
 
• **Hindustani Classical Music**
 
 
• Hindustani classical music is a tradition of Indian classical music originating from North India.
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan**
 
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award in India, given for exceptional and distinguished service in any field.
 
• It was instituted in 1954 and is awarded by the Government of India.
 
• Recipients of this award are recognized for their contributions to the arts, literature, science, and public service.
 
 
 
• **Global Recognition**
 
 
• Indian classical musicians like Pt. Ram Narayan have played a significant role in promoting Indian music on an international platform.
 
• They have collaborated with international artists and participated in global music festivals, showcasing the richness of Indian classical traditions.
